workpaper_submission.node_purpose: Map the two completed model-authored research reflections and their reviewed authority into one strict value-capture workpaper without repeating retrieval or financial analysis.
workpaper_submission.input_scale: The immutable R3 workpaper context is 92055 canonical JSON characters; the lossless non-duplicative submission view is 59241 characters and retains 15 Evidence items, 19 numeric authorities, 6 numeric relations, 9 gaps, 2 reflections, methods and graph context.
workpaper_submission.schema_burden: One strict tool payload with 12 top-level fields, up to 10 source-bound claims, exact Evidence/NumericFact/relation/gap enums and no new authority.
workpaper_submission.materiality_and_quality_risk: Very high because unsupported AI-profit attribution, dropped counterevidence or generic boundary prose would invalidate the financial judgment even though retrieval succeeded.
workpaper_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R3 used 33933 prompt tokens and exhausted all 16000 completion tokens; 13922 were reasoning tokens while 7257 characters of visible tool arguments were already present but truncated. The failure therefore comes from re-analysis competing with final submission, not from an undersized 12-field payload.
workpaper_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking disabled for contract submission only
workpaper_submission.stop_or_truncation_behavior: Exactly one transport attempt, no retry. Length finish, missing tool call, invalid JSON, unauthorized reference or contract failure terminates R4 and remains immutable. Required research work is not dropped or regenerated.

owner_decision_basis: R3 proved the dynamic research loop: the model selected all twelve bounded S1/S2 routes across two rounds, consumed FeedbackReceipts, changed its plan, covered all seven proposition groups and stopped with a justified boundary. Only the final max-thinking workpaper call exhausted its completion budget. The smallest responsible successor reuses the three successful provider calls and complete local validation context, presents one compact transport view and permits one non-thinking workpaper submission.
known_boundary: This decision does not declare S1 or S3 passed and does not authorize new evidence, retrieval, reflection, external network access, candidate promotion, multi-agent execution, Workbench publication or release. It authorizes one exact-once workpaper submission from the immutable R3 research checkpoint; L1 and content-quality assessment remain mandatory after a contract-valid result.
